title: Libya Primes The Pump
summary:
Production surge helps the tanker market
The big turnaround in Libya started in the fall of last year and in October 2016, production reached 510,000 b/d, 82% above the June levels. Libyan production continued to increase through January 2017 (690,000 b/d) before it stagnated for a few months. However, in May and June, production (and export) growth accelerated again.
